raw:
@q query
  mode every
  quantifier at_least 3
  where match
    relation "be on"
    role subject ?p
    role object "Deva Falcons"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "be certified"
    role subject ?p
    polarity affirmed
  end
